metadata.title: World Digest — November 25, 2026
metadata.summary: Trump's new tariffs on China and the EU risk retaliation as markets rebounded and inflation hit 3.8%.

sections.title: Major Events
sections.content:
Trump Unveils New Tariffs on 14 Partners, Including China and EU

The administration proposed sweeping tariffs on major trading partners, citing unfair practices, risking retaliation and global market upheaval. The Guardian

Ukraine Strikes Russian Oil Refinery, Killing One

A Ukrainian attack on a Samara refinery killed one person; Moscow vowed retaliation as refinery runs hit decades-low levels. The Moscow Times

Judge Upholds NYC Rent Freeze in Mamdani Win

A court ruled for Mayor Mamdani's rent freeze, a major victory for his affordability agenda over landlord challenges. The New York Times

Kilmar Abrego García Arrives in Spain After Deportation Ordeal

Illegally deported by the Trump administration, García voluntarily left the U.S. for Spain, ending his legal saga on his terms. The Washington Post

Judges Suggest Dropping Netanyahu Corruption Case

Israeli judges recommended dismissing the most serious charges against Netanyahu, giving the PM a major legal boost. The New York Times

sections.title: Political News
sections.content:
Global Politics

China's Politburo member and Shanghai party chief Chen Jining is under investigation, marking the latest purge of a once-rising star under President Xi Jinping NPR. South Africa's President Ramaphosa won a court battle, averting an impeachment inquiry over cash hidden at his farm BBC. Separately, Israel's judges suggested dropping a key corruption case against Prime Minister Netanyahu The New York Times.

Americas

Vice President Vance blamed former President Obama for toxic lead exposure risks in Iowa, following an Army detonation of lead azide The Hill. The DOJ walked back claims about searching Rep. Ilhan Omar's home, apologizing KTVB. Incoming House Democrats may skip Harvard orientation over a graduate student strike The Boston Globe.

sections.title: Financial News
sections.content:
Global Markets Rebound; Inflation, AI Turmoil Dominate

US stocks staged a stunning rebound, with the Dow erasing an 1,100-point loss to close higher CNBC. However, the Fed’s preferred inflation gauge accelerated to 3.8% in October, keeping rate-hike pressure ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos. Nvidia’s Jensen Huang apologized to employees amid a code-of-conduct scandal, with Trump administration clearing him of security risks TechCrunch Reuters. Trump’s accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year BBC. US Q3 GDP grew at a rapid 4.3% Axios. Lukoil’s overseas assets sold to Todd Boehly’s group CNN.

sections.title: Tech News
sections.content:
Anthropic Lets Claude-Generated Apps Run as Desktop Software

Anthropic now lets Claude-generated artifacts be installed as standalone desktop apps on Mac and Windows, a step toward eroding traditional software development SiliconANGLE. The feature builds on Claude's output generation, with coverage suggesting a broader push to make AI outputs directly usable beyond the browser.

Apple Tests macOS on iPads, Internally

Apple has iPads running macOS internally, but reportedly has no plans to release the feature MacRumors. The experiment suggests possible future convergence between iPadOS and macOS, though analysts caution it may remain an internal prototype.

GTA 6's Record Launch Spurs Controversy

Take-Two shut down an unauthorized GTA 6 PC port via DMCA Mashable, while the game's $3.79 billion debut draws both praise and debate over its empathy mechanics Kotaku Eurogamer.net. Rockstar's design director says empathy was added "because it's fun."

Kagi Launches Paid Gmail Rival

Search alternative Kagi opened Kagi Mail to public beta at $99 a year, taking on Gmail with a privacy-focused paid model Ars Technica.

sections.title: Sports
sections.content:
Basketball

  • Pistons 104, Magic 86 – Isaiah Joe scored 21 without Cade Cunningham to hand Orlando their first NBA Cup loss ESPN.
  • Celtics 131, Wizards 116 – Jayson Tatum’s 41 points snapped Boston’s four-game skid ESPN.
  • Mavericks 120, Nuggets 101 – Cooper Flagg posted 24 points and 12 assists in Dallas’ NBA Cup win ESPN.

Hockey

  • Golden Knights 5, Oilers 3 – Connelly and Eichel powered Vegas as Edmonton’s slump continued ESPN.

Football

  • Miami (OH) 28, Western Michigan 24 – Bellisari accounted for four TDs and Knighten’s late interception sealed it ESPN.

Soccer

  • Real Madrid 5, PSV 1 – Bellingham sparked a five-goal second-half blitz as Madrid stayed perfect in the Champions League ESPN.
  • Barcelona 4, Sabah FK 1 – Gordon scored twice to edge Barca closer to the knockouts ESPN.
  • Man City 2, Napoli 2 – Cherki’s magic denied Napoli, but City’s struggles persist ESPN.

Baseball

  • MLB sued the players’ union, asking a court to declare a potential lockout legal ESPN.

sections.title: Outlook
sections.content:
24–48 Hours: Market volatility persists; watch retaliatory tariff announcements from China/EU following Trump’s proposal. Oil supply fears may escalate after Ukraine's refinery strike—expect Moscow's response.

Next Week: Fed rate-path signals dominate as inflation hits 3.8%. Monitor Netanyahu case fallout; judges' recommendation could reshape Israeli politics.

Next Month: Potential MLB lockout looms as league sues union. Apple's macOS-on-iPad experiment may hint at convergence, though release unlikely. Trump-Nvidia trading scrutiny could intensify.

theme.name: Tariff Tension
theme.note: A trade war on the horizon, markets catching their breath, and a world bracing for retaliation — logged in amber ink on a dark, watchful page.
